scoring_justification: Full recompute of the thermodynamic calculation from raw artifacts is infeasible in the verifier sandbox; the paper-reported SFE values serve as hidden gold for a result-level comparison with appropriate tolerances and trend checks.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold SFE values at room temperature and high-temperature range for the three alloy variants.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Table 3 (predicted SFE at room temperature) and text in section 3.2 (SFE values rise up to 205 to 200 mJ/m² at 1323 K) of the original paper.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper’s reported model‑predicted numbers.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper’s own computational results, which the reproduction must approximate; they are not invented.

outputs.description: Predicted stacking fault energy for the three alloy variants at room temperature (298 K) and at 1323 K.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares the reported SFE_RT values to a reference set (paper's predicted values) with a predetermined tolerance. Additionally, it verifies that both SFE_RT and SFE_1323K values strictly decrease (or are non-increasing) as the total interstitial content increases, i.e., 7N > 11N > 22N. Both absolute value checks and trend enforcement contribute to the overall reward.
